working_tree_semantics: Round 5A was implemented and verified in the current uncommitted worktree. Existing user documentation changes were preserved. No files were staged, committed, or pushed.

execution_envelope.dispatch_planning: one absolute cooperative deadline per model call across safe-point freeze, source and tool-surface capture, pending-steer hydration, prefix trials, and prepared-input promotion
execution_envelope.foreground_canonical: one fresh closed-owner deadline per independent transaction, confirmation, retry, or content operation
execution_envelope.human_interaction: process-local waiter policy; no inherited turn or provider/tool watchdog
execution_envelope.strict_prefix_continuity: unchanged same-Host same-scope epoch contract; system and tools equal, messages equal or append-only suffix

canonical_and_physical_ownership.root_admission: stable prepared candidate with a Host-owned process-local settlement attempt that persists through transient confirmation failures until FULL, NONE, CONFLICT, or writer takeover; cancellation never reissues and any FULL winner is interrupted before slot release
canonical_and_physical_ownership.subagent_admission: the same persistent exact settlement contract as ROOT, plus an exact join between the immutable task objective and child initial canonical content
canonical_and_physical_ownership.tool_remote_identity: one stable prepared publication with FULL, NONE, or CONFLICT exact confirmation under the known-result settlement owner; ACK loss never discards the exact result or reruns the physical tool
canonical_and_physical_ownership.tool_late_exact_outcome: the process-local worker is drained once and its exact return or exception is preserved
canonical_and_physical_ownership.bounded_write_or_unknown_effect_exceptio: attempt remains without result, turn interrupts, and no physical retry occurs
canonical_and_physical_ownership.stale_writer_late_result: never crosses Host ownership; only a bounded process-local operational diagnostic remains
canonical_and_physical_ownership.terminal_launch: one exact process-local TerminalForegroundDecisionAttempt is installed before spawn and settles PREPARING, PROCESS_INSTALLED, RESULT_READY, or abort races
canonical_and_physical_ownership.terminal_process_actions: list/log/poll/wait are TERMINAL_OBSERVATION; write/submit/close_stdin/kill are TERMINAL_EFFECT, and the mapping participates in the immutable executor binding fingerprint
canonical_and_physical_ownership.host_close: one HostCore-installed shielded task owns stop, cancel, physical join, canonical terminalization, and map retirement; waiter cancellation only detaches; the canonical-close decision is frozen before its write and successful attempts are removed while failed attempts remain quarantined
canonical_and_physical_ownership.close_deadline: logical expiry selects a typed failure but the close task remains attached until every admitted physical thread/task is terminal; blob-GC task and I/O owner use the same join-beyond-deadline rule and waiter cancellation only detaches after join

deterministic_verification.full_pytest_after_reverse_review: not_rerun_by_explicit_user_instruction; replaced by adjacent and retained targeted suites plus the full PostgreSQL marker
deterministic_verification.full_pytest_reported_by_final_reverse_re: 482_passed_before_the_six_new_adjacent_regression_functions; not rerun by explicit user instruction
deterministic_verification.post_final_review_new_regressions: six unique new test functions; collection/full suite deliberately not rerun by explicit user instruction
deterministic_verification.sixty_four_model_calls: 63 tool-producing calls followed by one final response completed for ROOT and SUBAGENT_TASK
deterministic_verification.more_than_sixty_four_tools: 65 tool calls in one turn completed and finalized
deterministic_verification.busy_steer_after_call_24: consumed at the next exact safe point without restarting the turn or continuity epoch
deterministic_verification.user_cancel_after_call_24: canonical interruption and physical drain passed
deterministic_verification.dispatch_planning_deadline: one planning deadline per model call; consumption and settlement use fresh canonical deadlines
deterministic_verification.provider_sse: both OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions complete when activity remains below read-idle even when total duration is longer; silent gaps timeout
deterministic_verification.tool_exception_matrix: read-only and Terminal observation known-failure branches plus bounded-write, unknown-effect, and Terminal-effect unknown branches passed
deterministic_verification.terminal_decision_races: PREPARING, PROCESS_INSTALLED, and RESULT_READY races preserve exact process identity and sibling isolation
deterministic_verification.close_waiter_cancellation: a later waiter joins the same task and no second physical close starts
deterministic_verification.close_physical_drain: logical deadline expiry remains pending until the exact physical worker exits, then reports typed timeout
deterministic_verification.writer_stale_late_result: zero result commit under the replacement writer
deterministic_verification.known_result_cancel_settlement: after exact physical return, one shielded process-local attempt owns remote identity, artifact preparation, exact ToolResult confirmation, and process-local effect settlement before cancellation interrupts the turn
deterministic_verification.cancelled_turn_admission: ROOT and SUBAGENT_TASK confirmation never reissue after explicit cancellation; FULL is interrupted before cancellation returns and NONE opens no provider
deterministic_verification.transient_turn_admission_confirmation: Host-owned process-local settlement remains joined across transient confirmation failures; ROOT cancellation interrupts the exact FULL winner and subagent ACK loss opens one runner exactly once
deterministic_verification.remote_identity_ack_unknown: the immutable remote-identity candidate survives a lost write acknowledgement and transient confirmation failure; ToolResult commits once and physical invocation count remains one
deterministic_verification.subagent_objective_join: admission rejects mismatched initial content and FULL confirmation becomes CONFLICT if task coordination truth diverges from the frozen objective
deterministic_verification.blob_gc_shutdown_join: logical timeout and caller cancellation both remain pending until the exact GC task and KernelSessionIO owner are terminal, after which the typed timeout or cancellation is reported
deterministic_verification.terminal_post_spawn_rollback: subscription, state publication, reader, watcher, and lifetime timer faults kill and join the exact process and release subscription, decision, state, and launch reservation exactly once
deterministic_verification.close_decision_and_retirement: late close-conversation upgrades are typed rejects after the decision fence; successful attempts retain no session/task graph and failed attempts remain quarantined
deterministic_verification.watchdog_policy_composition: HostCore creates one policy used by foreground, jobs, and Inspector; memory point/search retain their independent 10/20-second owner contracts

real_provider_dogfood.database: fresh clean-v0 ephemeral database force-dropped after verification; user database untouched
